'''Bobbi La Queef''' is a cut character in {{SA}}.

==Description==
Bobbi was a cut [[Girlfriends in GTA San Andreas|girlfriend]], originally intended to be found at the [[Verona Beach Gym]] in [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]]. She is described a a stereotypical {{WP|Beverly Hills}}-style cheerleader.

According to [[Rockstar North]]'s "Game Ideas Doc" for ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas'', dated [[2002]], Bobbi's house is ambiguously located in the Beverly Hills-inspired areas of Los Santos.{{Ref|name = gtasagdd-bobbi|type = designdoc|date = 12/25/2024|ref = "Girlfriend 2; Bobbi La Queef"; ''GTA San Andreas: Game Ideas Doc - 1st November 2002.'' Rockstar North. (Page 3)}}

==Leftovers==
Bobbi's bedroom interior model "<code>bobbi-room01</code>" (ID: 14865) can be found in the game at X: 267.2290, Y: 304.7100, Z: 999.1480 in [[Interiors in GTA San Andreas|Interior World]] 2, intended to be reused for [[Katie Zhan]]. It is identified as Bobbi's original room through its model file name and its cheerleader-themed decorations (sports team flags).
